snippet.title: Harry And Hermione Save Sirius | Full Scene | Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
snippet.description:
Harry and Hermione use the Time-Turner in order to travel back in time and save Sirius from his terrible fate. Harry, however, must realise that only he himself, and not his father, can conjure the spectacular Patronus that protects Sirius from the swarm of Dementors, and ultimately saves his life.

The Harry Potter: Complete 8-Film Collection is available on Blu-ray and Digital now.
